name: Orbclo Dev Orbit
author: onisY
description: Add clear selected-date feedback: a calendar date chosen by double tap now blinks with a yellow background every 500 ms, alternating with its normal holiday/weekend/today color until returning to Orbit. Use the existing low-cost 6x8x2 digit renderer for the blink. Preserve the intentional language/holiday coupling: Japanese display always uses Japan holidays; English display uses the selected England/Wales, Scotland, or Northern Ireland bank-holiday region. Region generators/settings were cross-checked for 2026 and 2027 against official Japan Cabinet Office/NAOJ and GOV.UK bank-holiday dates.
